hero.title: Farewell with Grace,
hero.zhLine: 慈悲 · 庄严 · 安详
hero.paragraph: Singapore Buddhist Funeral Services provides dignified Buddhist funerals — honouring your loved one with proper rites, mindful care and a serene farewell, available around the clock.
hero.paragraphZh: 新加坡佛教殡葬服务为您提供庄严的佛教殡葬礼仪——以如法的仪轨、细心的照料与宁静的告别，恭送您的至亲，全天候为您服务。

strip.text: Immediate assistance, day or night — our advisors will guide you through every step.
strip.textZh: 无论昼夜，即时协助——我们的顾问将引导您完成每一个步骤。
strip.buttonZh: 立即 WhatsApp 联系我们

about.title: Caring for families
about.lead: We exist for one reason — so that no family should have to face the loss of a loved one alone.
about.leadZh: 我们的存在只有一个理由——让每一个家庭在痛失至亲时，都不必独自承担。
about.storyText: From the very first call to the final prayers, we shoulder the arrangements, the paperwork and the rites — quietly and respectfully — so that you can spend these precious days close to the people who matter most. Every detail is handled with the same care we would give our own family.
about.storyTextZh: 从您致电的那一刻，直到最后的诵经送别，我们承担起所有安排、文件与仪轨——安静而恭敬——让您能将这段珍贵的时光，留给最重要的家人。每一个细节，我们都以对待至亲的心意悉心处理。
about.philosophyText: A farewell should reflect the life it honours. We hold fast to time-honoured customs and religious rites, while embracing thoughtful, modern touches — so that every service feels personal and sincere, never templated.
about.philosophyTextZh: 告别，应当映照出逝者走过的一生。我们坚守传统习俗与宗教仪轨，同时融入用心的现代细节——让每一场仪式都真挚而独特，绝非千篇一律。

commitments.title: Every Faith, Every Tradition
commitments.titleZh: 尊重每一种信仰与传统
commitments.text: Buddhist, Taoist, Christian or free-thinker — we arrange the rites faithfully according to your family's beliefs and dialect customs.
commitments.textZh: 佛教、道教、基督教或自由思想者——我们都依照您家庭的信仰与籍贯习俗，如实安排各项仪式。

commitments.title: Clear, Honest Pricing
commitments.text: Complete packages with no hidden charges. We explain every cost before you decide, so there are no surprises during a difficult time.
commitments.textZh: 配套完整，绝无隐藏费用。在您决定之前，我们会清楚说明每一项收费，让您在艰难时刻不必担心意外开销。

commitments.title: Present at Every Step
commitments.text: A dedicated funeral director stays with your family throughout and is reachable day or night — help is only ever a phone call away.
commitments.textZh: 专属的殡葬顾问将全程陪伴您的家庭，昼夜皆可联系——只需一通电话，我们便在您身边。

etiquette.title: Etiquette &
etiquette.lead: If you are visiting to pay your respects, a few simple customs are good to know — though our staff are always on hand to guide you.
etiquette.leadZh: 若您前来吊唁，了解几项简单的礼俗会有所帮助——而我们的工作人员也随时在旁为您引导。

items.title: What to Wear
items.text: Dress modestly in muted tones such as white, black, blue or grey. It is customary to avoid bright colours and especially red, which signifies celebration.
items.textZh: 请以素雅的色调端庄着装，如白、黑、蓝或灰色。习俗上应避免鲜艳的颜色，尤其是象征喜庆的红色。

items.title: Offering Respects
items.text: Approach the altar, offer a joss stick or a quiet bow, and observe a moment of silence. If you are unsure of the customs, simply follow the family's lead or ask our staff.
items.textZh: 请走近灵桌，上一炷香或轻轻鞠躬，并默哀片刻。若不熟悉礼俗，只需跟随家属的引导，或向我们的工作人员询问。

items.title: A Quiet Presence
items.text: There is no need for elaborate words — your presence alone brings comfort. You are welcome to sit with the family, share a memory, or simply be near.
items.textZh: 无需多言——您的到来本身便是慰藉。欢迎您陪坐在家属身旁、分享一段回忆，或只是静静相伴。

items.title: What the Family Provides
items.text: A recent photograph for the memorial portrait, a set of the departed's clothing, and their identity documents are all that is needed — we take care of everything else.
items.textZh: 只需准备一张近照作为遗照、一套逝者的衣物，以及其身份证件——其余一切皆由我们处理。

steps.title: When a loved one
steps.lead: In the first hours, you do not need to face the arrangements alone. Call us first — we will handle everything that follows.
steps.leadZh: 在最初的时刻，您无需独自面对各项安排。请先致电我们——后续的一切都交由我们处理。

items.title: Call Us First
items.text: Contact our 24-hour hotline. Our advisor will guide you calmly through what needs to be done, wherever the passing occurred.
items.textZh: 请拨打我们的24小时热线。无论在何处离世，我们的顾问都会平和地引导您处理需要办理的事宜。

items.title: Certification of Death
items.text: We assist with the doctor's Certificate of Cause of Death (CCOD) and the official death documentation required in Singapore.
items.textZh: 我们协助办理医生开具的死亡原因证明书（CCOD）及新加坡所需的官方死亡文件。

items.title: Bringing Them Home
items.text: Our team transfers your loved one with care to the wake venue — void deck, funeral parlour or your home — and prepares the setup.
items.textZh: 我们的团队将妥善地把您的至亲送往灵堂——组屋底层、殡仪馆或您的住所——并完成布置。

items.title: The Wake & Rites Begin
items.text: We arrange the altar, casket and monk chanting rites, so your family can focus on being present with one another.
items.textZh: 我们安排佛坛、棺木及僧人诵经法事，让您的家人能够安心地彼此相伴。

services.title: Our
services.lead: A full Buddhist funeral service, arranged end to end — every detail handled with reverence.
services.leadZh: 完整的佛教殡葬服务，从头到尾悉心安排——每个细节皆以虔敬之心处理。

items.title: Wake Arrangements
items.text: Full setup at HDB void deck, funeral parlour or private residence — tentage, altar, Buddha image, floral arrangements, photo enlargement and nightly support.
items.textZh: 在组屋底层、殡仪馆或私人住所完成全套布置——帐篷、佛坛、佛像、花艺布置、遗照放大及每晚的协助。

items.title: Monk Chanting Rites
items.text: Venerable monks conduct chanting and transference-of-merit rites — at the encoffinment, nightly prayers, funeral day and cremation, per Mahayana or Theravada tradition.
items.textZh: 礼请法师进行诵经及超度回向法事——于入殓、每晚诵经、出殡日及火化时，依大乘或南传传统进行。

items.title: Encoffinment & Embalming
items.text: Professional embalming, dressing and encoffinment performed with dignity, with a quality casket appropriate to Buddhist customs.
items.textZh: 以庄重之心进行专业防腐、净身更衣与入殓，并备有契合佛教礼俗的优质棺木。

items.title: Cremation & Ash Collection
items.text: Booking of the cremation slot at Mandai Crematorium, hearse and family transport, and respectful ash collection the following day.
items.textZh: 预订万礼火化场时段、灵车及家属接送，并于翌日恭敬捡灰。

items.title: Post-Funeral Prayers
items.text: Arrangement of 7th-day (头七), 49-day (七七) and 100-day memorial prayers, guiding your loved one's journey and bringing comfort to the family.
items.textZh: 安排头七、七七（四十九天）及百日追思法事，引导至亲的旅程，并抚慰家属。

items.title: Columbarium & Sea Burial
items.text: Guidance on niche selection at government or temple columbaria, or arrangement of sea scattering with the appropriate Buddhist ritual.
items.textZh: 提供政府或寺院骨灰位选择的指引，或安排如法的佛教海葬仪式。

gallery.title: A serene
gallery.lead: Glimpses of the dignified arrangements and tranquil settings we prepare for every family.
gallery.leadZh: 撷取我们为每个家庭精心准备的庄严安排与宁静场景。

rites.title: Buddhist funeral
rites.lead: Each rite carries deep meaning — generating merit for the departed and guiding them peacefully toward their next journey.
rites.leadZh: 每项仪轨皆蕴含深意——为亡者积累功德，引导他们安详地迈向下一段旅程。

items.title: Encoffinment Rite
items.text: Monks chant as your loved one is laid into the casket, blessing the departed and sanctifying the beginning of the wake.
items.textZh: 僧人于您的至亲入棺时诵经，为亡者祝祷，并为灵堂的开始加以圣化。

items.title: Nightly Chanting
items.text: Evening sutra recitations — commonly the Amitabha Sutra — transfer merit to the departed while bringing calm to the bereaved.
items.textZh: 夜间诵经——常诵《阿弥陀经》——为亡者回向功德，同时为家属带来安宁。

items.title: Funeral Day Service
items.text: The final-day rite includes prayers, last respects and the procession, conducted with solemnity before the cortege departs for cremation.
items.textZh: 末日仪式包括诵经、瞻仰遗容及送殡行列，在灵柩启程火化前庄严举行。

items.title: 49 Days of Prayers
items.text: In Buddhist belief, the consciousness journeys for up to 49 days. Weekly prayers, especially the 7th and 49th day, support a favourable rebirth.
items.textZh: 佛教相信，神识在四十九天内仍在旅程之中。每周诵经，尤其是头七与第四十九天，有助于亡者获得善的往生。

packages.title: Funeral
packages.lead: Every package is complete — no hidden costs. Speak with our advisors for current pricing and customisation.
packages.leadZh: 每个配套皆为完整服务——绝无隐藏费用。欢迎与我们的顾问洽询最新价格与定制方案。

items.name: 3-Day Wake
featuresZh: 僧人诵经——入殓与出殡日

items.name: 5-Day Wake
features: Floral & fruit altar offerings refreshed daily
featuresZh: 包含三日配套的所有项目
每日更新的鲜花与供果

items.name: 7-Day Wake
featuresZh: 包含五日配套的所有项目
四十九天与百日法事安排

items.q: What should I do immediately when a loved one passes at home?
items.qZh: 至亲在家中离世时，我该立即怎么做？
items.a: Call a doctor to certify the death (we can arrange one), then call our 24-hour hotline. Our team will take care of the transfer, documentation and all funeral arrangements from there.
items.aZh: 请致电医生开具死亡证明（我们可代为安排），然后拨打我们的24小时热线。我们的团队将从接送、文件办理到所有殡葬安排，全程为您处理。

items.q: Can the wake be held at an HDB void deck?
items.qZh: 丧礼可以在组屋底层举行吗？
items.a: Yes. We obtain the necessary town council permit and handle the complete setup — tentage, lighting, altar, seating and nightly security — at the void deck, a funeral parlour, or your home.
items.aZh: 可以。我们会向市镇理事会申请所需准证，并完成全套布置——帐篷、照明、佛坛、座位及每晚的保安——无论是在组屋底层、殡仪馆或您的住所。

items.q: Do you serve both Mahayana and Theravada traditions?
items.qZh: 你们同时提供大乘与南传（上座部）传统的服务吗？
items.a: Yes. We work with venerable monks of both traditions and will arrange rites according to your family's practice and dialect group customs.
items.aZh: 是的。我们礼请两种传统的法师，并会依据您家庭的修持与籍贯习俗安排相应的仪轨。

items.a: We accompany you for ash collection, then assist with your chosen resting place — a columbarium niche, sea scattering with Buddhist ritual, or other arrangements — plus the 7th-day, 49-day and 100-day prayers.
items.aZh: 我们将陪同您捡灰，随后协助安排您选择的安息之所——骨灰位、如法的佛教海葬，或其他安排——并办理头七、四十九天及百日法事。

contact.title: Contact
contact.cardSubtitle: A service of Singapore Bereavement Group Pte Ltd
contact.cardSubtitleZh: 由 Singapore Bereavement Group Pte Ltd 提供的服务
contact.noteTitle: In your most difficult hour, call us first.
contact.noteTitleZh: 在您最艰难的时刻，请先致电我们。
contact.noteText: Our advisors respond at any hour, every day. Let us shoulder the arrangements while you stay close to your family.
contact.noteTextZh: 我们的顾问全天候、每日为您解答。让我们承担各项安排，您只需安心陪伴家人。

contact.formNoteZh: 请留下您的联系方式，我们将尽快回复。如有紧急事宜，请拨打我们的 24 小时热线。

packages.metaTitleZh: 新加坡佛教殡葬配套（3、5、7天）| 透明价格
packages.metaDescription: Complete 3, 5 & 7-day Buddhist funeral packages in Singapore — casket, embalming, wake setup, monk chanting and cremation. Transparent, no hidden costs.
packages.metaDescriptionZh: 新加坡完整的3天、5天与7天佛教殡葬配套——涵盖棺木、防腐、灵堂布置、僧人诵经与火化。价格透明，绝无隐藏费用。
packages.lead: Complete 3, 5 and 7-day Buddhist funeral packages, arranged end to end — with clear, all-inclusive pricing and no hidden costs.
packages.leadZh: 完整的3天、5天与7天佛教殡葬配套，由始至终悉心安排——价格清晰、全包到底，绝无隐藏费用。
packages.intro: Losing someone you love is overwhelming, and the last thing a grieving family should have to face is piecing a funeral together alone. Our Buddhist funeral packages bring every element of a dignified farewell under one arrangement — from the casket and encoffinment to the monk chanting rites, the nightly prayers and the cremation. Each package is complete and prepared according to Mahayana or Theravada tradition, so your family can be fully present with one another while we quietly take care of everything else.
packages.introZh: 痛失至亲令人难以承受，而悲伤中的家属最不该独自张罗整场丧礼。我们的佛教殡葬配套将庄严告别的每一个环节都纳入同一安排——从棺木、入殓，到僧人诵经、每晚祈福与火化。每个配套皆完整齐备，并依大乘或南传传统办理，让您的家人能安心彼此相伴，其余一切交由我们悉心打理。
packages.included: Every Buddhist funeral package covers the essentials of a proper wake and send-off: a quality casket suited to Buddhist customs, professional embalming, dressing and encoffinment, and a full wake setup with a Buddhist altar, Buddha image, floral arrangements and an enlarged memorial portrait. Venerable monks conduct the encoffinment rite and the funeral-day chanting, transferring merit to the departed. We book the cremation slot at Mandai, arrange the hearse and family transport, and accompany you for the respectful collection of ashes the following day. Longer packages add nightly chanting sessions, daily refreshed altar offerings and a dedicated funeral director present throughout.
packages.includedZh: 每个佛教殡葬配套都涵盖如法治丧与送别的基本所需：契合佛教礼俗的优质棺木、专业防腐、净身更衣与入殓，以及完整的灵堂布置，包括佛坛、佛像、花艺与放大的遗照。法师主持入殓仪式与出殡日诵经，为亡者回向功德。我们预订万礼火化场时段、安排灵车与家属接送，并于翌日陪同您恭敬捡灰。较长的配套另加每晚诵经、每日更新的供品，以及全程在场的专属殡葬顾问。
packages.duration: Buddhist wakes in Singapore are most commonly held over three, five or seven days, and families often choose an odd number of days in keeping with custom. A three-day wake suits an intimate farewell among close family; a five-day wake — the most frequently chosen — gives relatives and friends from near and far the time to pay their respects; and a seven-day wake allows for a fuller traditional observance with additional prayer sessions. There is no single right answer — the right length is the one that lets your family grieve, gather and say goodbye without feeling rushed. Our advisors will help you weigh the options calmly.
packages.durationZh: 在新加坡，佛教守灵通常为三天、五天或七天，家属往往依习俗选择单数天数。三天守灵适合至亲之间的私密告别；五天守灵——最常被选择——让远近的亲友都有时间前来吊唁；七天守灵则可进行更完整的传统仪式，并增加诵经场次。并没有唯一正确的答案——最合适的天数，是能让您的家人从容地哀悼、团聚与道别的那一个。我们的顾问会平和地协助您权衡选择。
packages.costsTitleZh: 价格透明，绝无隐藏费用
packages.costs: We believe a grieving family deserves complete clarity. Every package is all-inclusive and explained in full before you commit, so there are no surprise charges during an already difficult time. Pricing depends on the wake venue, the chosen duration and any personal touches your family would like to add. Because circumstances and budgets differ, we share current pricing and prepare a tailored quotation when you speak with us.
packages.costsZh: 我们相信，悲伤中的家属理应得到完全的清晰透明。每个配套皆全包在内，并在您决定之前详细说明，让您在艰难时刻不必担心意外收费。价格取决于灵堂场地、所选天数，以及您的家人希望加入的任何个人化安排。由于每个家庭的情况与预算不同，当您与我们联系时，我们会提供当前价格并备妥量身定制的报价。
packages.closing: To discuss packages, pricing or a custom arrangement, call our 24-hour hotline or send an enquiry — an advisor will respond at any hour, every day, and guide you gently through what comes next.
packages.closingZh: 如需洽谈配套、价格或定制安排，请拨打我们的24小时热线或发送咨询——顾问全天候、每日为您解答，并温柔地引导您完成接下来的每一步。
